tools.name: get_today_races
tools.description: Today's GB & IRE horse races with Racing Alpha's published model picks (advised prices are database-frozen at publication). Returns race ids usable with get_race_signals.

tools.name: get_race_signals
tools.description: Racing Alpha's derived signals for one race: per-runner AI score (0-100), de-overrounded fair price, value vs fair, plus race-level draw-bias verdict and the frozen model pick if the race made the public card.

tools.name: get_tips_ledger
tools.description: Racing Alpha's public tips ledger — every pick database-frozen at publication with result, level-stakes P/L, and closing-line-value summary. Includes losses; that is the point.

tools.name: get_draw_bias
tools.description: 3-year draw-bias aggregates for GB & IRE flat courses: impact value (IV), actual/expected (A-E) and percentage-of-rivals-beaten (PRB) by stall third, per course, surface and distance band.

tools.name: get_combo_stats
tools.description: Trainer×jockey combination strike rates over settled GB & IRE races in Racing Alpha's archive.
